seo_title: AVRIX | Cyber Security for UK & European Businesses
seo_description: AVRIX Digital helps UK and European organisations test, monitor and prove their cyber security: penetration testing, 24/7 monitoring, Cyber Essentials, ISO 27001, GDPR, NIS2 and DORA.

sections.h1: Cyber security that keeps your business *open, compliant and trusted*
sections.lead: We find the gaps attackers would use, watch your systems around the clock and give you the evidence customers, insurers and regulators ask for. Explained in plain English, priced before we start.

sections.title: Security services built around *your real risks*
sections.intro: Most clients come to us with one pressing need: a tender, an audit, an insurer's question or a worrying email. These are the services that solve them most often.

sections.title: Sector know-how, *not one-size-fits-all*
sections.intro: A clinic, a payments firm and a factory face different attackers and different rules. Pick your sector to see what usually matters most.

sections.title: Find it. Watch it. Prove it. *Recover from it.*
sections.intro: Four connected disciplines, one team and one point of contact, so nothing falls between suppliers.

items.title: Find it

sections.title: What makes AVRIX *different*
sections.intro: We're judged on whether you're safer and can prove it, not on how long the report is.

items.title: Board-ready, not just tech-ready
items.text: Every engagement ends with a one-page summary of business risk your directors can act on, alongside the technical detail.

items.title: Right-sized and fixed-price
items.text: We scope to what you actually need to protect or prove, then quote a fixed price. No padded day rates, no tools you don't need.

items.title: UK and EU rules in-house
items.text: Cyber Essentials, UK and EU GDPR, NIS2, DORA and the NHS toolkit are everyday work for us, not a referral elsewhere.

items.title: We stay until it's fixed
items.text: We walk your team through the findings, help with the fixes and retest penetration test issues, so the risk actually goes away.

sections.title: Listen, scope, assess, fix, *prove*
sections.intro: The same five steps whether it's a single test or an ongoing service.

items.label: Step 1 · Listen
items.title: A free scoping call
items.text: We learn what you need to protect, who's asking and by when, before suggesting anything.

items.label: Step 2 · Scope
items.title: A fixed-price proposal
items.text: Clear scope, timings and price in writing. For testing, you sign authorisation before we touch a system.

items.label: Step 3 · Assess
items.title: The work itself
items.text: Testing, monitoring set-up or a compliance review, with a named lead you can call at any point.

items.label: Step 4 · Fix
items.title: Help closing the gaps
items.text: A walkthrough with your team, practical fixes and retesting where it applies.

items.label: Step 5 · Prove
items.title: Evidence you can share
items.text: Reports, letters and evidence packs ready for customers, auditors, insurers and the board.
